title: CWP/21194/2023 of HARBHAJAN SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text: -8IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision: 14.05.2025 Harbhajan Singh ...Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and others ...Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SURESHWAR THAKUR HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIKAS SURI Present:- Mr. Rishu Mahajan, Advocate, for the petitioner. Mr. Mohit Kapoor, Sr. DAG, Punjab. Mr. Deepak Goyat, Advocate, for Mr. Ashwani Talwar, Advocate, for GMADA. Mr. Mohit Rathee, Advocate, for respondents No.3 to 6. SURESHWAR THAKUR, J. (ORAL) For orders, see detailed judgment of even date passed in CWP-20106-2021, titled as New Sunny Enclave Residents Social Welfare Association Regd. and another vs. State of Punjab and others. ( SURESHWAR THAKUR ) JUDGE ( VIKAS SURI ) May 14, 2025 JUDGE harish
